A11ySection.title: Accessability always included
A11ySection.paragraph1: Accessibility is not an afterthought — I build it in from the start. Semantic HTML, keyboard navigation and proper ARIA attributes are part of every component I write.
A11ySection.paragraph2: I follow WCAG guidelines and test with screen readers to make sure interfaces work for everyone, regardless of how they interact with the web.
A11ySection.interactiveText: Use the controls below to modify this text

ColorContrastItem.label: Color contrast
ColorContrastItem.description: Color contrast measures the perceived brightness difference between foreground and background. WCAG 2.1 requires a minimum ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text (AA) and 7:1 for enhanced readability (AAA).

helperText.fail: Insufficient contrast — fails all WCAG requirements. Try a lighter or darker color.
helperText.a: Meets level A — only suitable for large or bold text.
helperText.aa: Meets level AA — the recommended standard for most text.
helperText.aaa: Meets level AAA — maximum contrast for optimal readability.

FontSizeItem.label: Font size
FontSizeItem.description: Font size directly affects readability. Below 12px text becomes hard to read for most users. 16px is the browser default and widely considered the accessible baseline.

helperText.error: Too small for comfortable reading. Increase to at least 12px.
helperText.warning: Readable but borderline. 16px or larger is recommended.
helperText.success: Good size for accessible, comfortable reading.

LanguageSection.title: Foreign languages
LanguageSection.paragraph1: Foreign languages have always fascinated me — not just as a communication tool, but as a window into different cultures and ways of thinking.
LanguageSection.paragraph2: I actively learn new languages and try to use them every day. Each new language is a new way of understanding the world.

interfaces.title: Building modern interfaces
interfaces.description: I build interfaces that feel smooth from the first interaction. React, Next.js and a component-driven approach. I focus on performance, structure and details that users notice immediately. From Figma to production, I keep things consistent and scalable.

systems.title: Powering robust systems
systems.description: I build backend systems that do their job and do not get in the way. Node.js with NestJS or Express for APIs and integrations. Clear structure, no unnecessary complexity, and systems that can grow without breaking. I work with both SQL and NoSQL, depending on what actually fits the use case.

tools.title: Tools that get things done
tools.description: TypeScript keeps the code predictable and consistent. Linux is my daily environment. Figma is where ideas take shape before they turn into real interfaces. I keep commits clean and readable, and I work comfortably with Agile workflows. I also document things clearly using tools like Notion, Google Docs or Confluence.
